item.title: Smart Contract Toolchains in 2026: Foundry vs Hardhat vs Brownie (Truffle Is Dead)
item.description: In September 2023 ConsenSys sunset Truffle. Three years later its repository still carries 13,903 stars — more than any living competitor — and its last commit is dated 2024-04-22. That gap between popularity and maintenance is the clearest lesson in smart contract tooling: star counts measure history, not health. Teams that picked Truffle by stars spent 2024 migrating under deadline.
